시편 110:1.content: A Psalm of David. The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

시편 110:2.content: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

시편 110:3.content: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

시편 110:4.content: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

시편 110:5.content: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

시편 110:6.content: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

시편 110:7.content: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
